verdict.rationale: Notion's core product is docs/notes organized alongside databases and project tracking, with strong community corroboration of collaborative, flexible organization spanning individuals to enterprise teams (notion-comm-2, notion-comm-4, notion-comm-12, notion-comm-14), plus docs on unifying content into one system of record (notion-docs-6) and real-time collaborative editing praised by users (notion-comm-15). Missing for 10: no first-party evidence specifically calling out 'project work' integration workflows beyond general database/wiki use, and some community notes cite organizational limits at scale (notion-comm-6).
